edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer indexes balances with msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the minted _totalSupply.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without SafeMath.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping through safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping through safeSub/safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed nested mapping before the external call.
transferOwnership is gated by the owner state variable in onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner) and rewrites owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner and transfers foreign tokens to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and reads the pending owner.
transferOwnership sets the newOwner state variable, changing the ownership state machine.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner and zeroes newOwner.
transfer delegates its balance math to safeSub.
transfer delegates its balance math to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance math to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates balance math to safeAdd.
transfer computes safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
transfer computes safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
transferFrom computes safeSub(balances[from], tokens) for an arbitrary from address.
transferFrom computes safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens).
transferFrom computes safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).

The untrusted receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall (and transferFrom) before approveAndCall returns.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into a caller-supplied contract.
totalSupply performs the raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
